meta.name: website-to-video
meta.description: Capture a general website/URL and turn it into a video OF the site — tour, showcase, or social clip built from captured screenshots and the site's own brand assets. Use for portfolio / blog / docs / landing-page showcases. Not a product launch or promo, even from a URL (/product-launch-video). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意网页转为展示视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把网页内容录制成视频用于分享或展示。
copy.tagline_en: Turn any webpage into a showcase video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to record a webpage as a video for sharing or presentation.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以捕获指定网站的内容，并基于截图和品牌素材生成该网站的视频，如网站导览、展示或社交媒体短片。
howto.when: 当用户要求将某个网站链接转换为视频，且意图是展示网站本身（如作品集、博客、文档或落地页）时触发。

say.text: 把这个网站做成一个15秒的Instagram短视频。
say.note: Claude 会捕获网站并生成符合平台尺寸的短片。

say.text: 为 https://example.com 制作一个30秒的网站导览视频。
say.note: Claude 会分析网站内容并生成带旁白的导览。

say.text: 捕获我们的首页，用它的视觉元素做一个展示视频。
say.note: Claude 会提取品牌颜色、字体等资产并制作视频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can capture a specified website URL and generate a video of that site—such as a tour, showcase, or social clip—using captured screenshots and the site's own brand assets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to turn a website URL into a video, and the intent is to showcase the site itself (e.g., portfolio, blog, docs, or landing page).

say_en.text: Turn this website into a 15-second social clip for Instagram.
say_en.note: Claude will capture the site and produce a short video in the platform's format.

say_en.text: Make a 30-second site tour from https://example.com.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the site and generate a narrated walkthrough.

say_en.text: Capture our homepage and build a video from its own visuals.
say_en.note: Claude will extract brand colors, fonts, and assets to create the video.
